About Claire's Inc. Claire's Inc. is a jewelry and accessories retailer aimed at tweens and teens, known for its ear-piercing services and mall-based stores. The company has filed for bankruptcy twice and closed many locations in recent years. It now operates through remaining stores and partnerships with retailers such as Walmart and CVS. Claire's Inc. suffered a cyberattack that disrupted its operations and compromised customers and employees data.

About PennEastern Architects LCC The principals of PennEastern Engineers, LLC are Paul Pasonick, Andrew Pasonick, Michael Amato and Daryl Pawlush. All principals have extensive experience in commercial and residential land developments, municipal projects, sanitary sewer projects, storm water projects, pavement projects, flood control projects and soil erosion and sedimentation control plans. In addition, each has assisted in design, specification writing, cost estimating, project bidding and bid review, construction observation and project management of the various projects. The Principals of PennEastern Architects, LLC are Andrew Pasonick, Emil Jarolen and Norman Manovsky. Design Principal Emil Jarolen has been practicing Architecture since 1974 and has been a Registered Architect in the State of Pennsylvania since 1978. As a result of a cyberattack on Company PennEastern Architects, more than 100 GB of corporate data was stolen. The breach includes a large volume of confidential information, including drawings and project documentation, data on the company’s customers and employees, as well as documents containing banking and financial information. Currently, approximately 60,000 files are unprotected by Company PennEastern Architects.

About Franklin Miller Inc. Franklin Miller has been engineering wastewater grinders, crushers, shredders, and screens for municipal and industrial applications since 1918. Their products are designed for reliability and efficiency, catering to industries such as wastewater treatment, food processing, mining, oil and gas, and recycling. The company is committed to providing comprehensive post-sale support, ensuring that their equipment operates at peak performance. Trusted by industry leaders worldwide, Franklin Miller's equipment is precision manufactured in the USA to handle the toughest jobs. As a result of the attack on "Franklin Miller", more than 250 GB of confidential data were stolen. The organization lost control over documents such as drawings and project documentation, confidential agreements, banking and other financial information, as well as employees’ personal data.

Pedigo Products, Inc. is a privately held American manufacturer of stainless steel and chromium medical equipment for the healthcare industry. It disregards its own security, as well as that of its customers and employees, and makes no attempt to negotiate agreements to prevent data leaks. As a result, we provide you with 1.3 TB of sensitive corporate data, such as: carrier account numbers, customer-specific pricing, commission adjustments, customs/MDEL identifiers and customer/employee contact information, customer contracts, price and discount schedules, shipping and routing instructions, employee and customer personal data, FDA quality records (DMR, DHR, DHF, CAPA, complaints, MDR), CAD files and trade secrets, intellectual property and non-disclosure agreements, financial statements, tax returns, payroll records, bank details, and legal documents. Contractual obligations to customers and confidentiality, as well as HIPAA/GDPR/CCPA/PIPEDA regulations, were violated. We urge the authorities to pay attention to these issues. Due to Pedigo's negligence, it will also suffer losses in the form of loss of trade secrets and intellectual property protection, copying by competitors, loss of business with hospitals and dealers, and serious reputational and financial damage.

Valenti Management is known as the Tampa-based Wendy's franchise operator. They are extremely lax when it comes to cybersecurity and are unwilling to cooperate in preventing data leaks, which is why we offer you commercial and confidential documents such as: price lists and discount agreements with key suppliers/distributors; new product/menu launch plans and marketing strategies; franchise and partnership contracts; terms of supplier discounts and promotions; employee personal data (Social Security numbers, wage data, taxes, benefits, medical records); financial statements, tax returns, bank statements, and debt agreements; real estate leases, construction contracts, and area development plans; customer loyalty program and payment card data; supply chain logistics data, inventory, and confidential operational data; litigation, insurance, and internal audit files. As a result, they will lose their reputation with clients and employees and face legal action due to the leak.

A private ophthalmology clinic specializing in various fields. However, it completely fails to ensure the security of itself and its clients and is extremely lax in its recordkeeping. The structure of its confidential records is determined by the categories of protected health information (PHI) it creates and stores. Because Concord Eye Center makes no attempt to regulate security, we provide you with the following information: patient identification and administrative data: this includes names, addresses, dates of birth, social security numbers, and contact information; clinical and medical history: detailed symptom records, ophthalmological and systemic medical history, and family history; diagnostic and lab results; surgical and treatment documentation; billing and financial information: insurance information, claims data, and payment records. Leaking these documents would primarily violate the HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (45 CFR Parts 160 and 164) and the HITECH Act, which provide for tiered civil penalties for each category of violation, leading to distrust of their business by customers and partners and its collapse.

Greentech Environmental LLC, a manufacturer of air purification systems using patented ODOGard and ARC technologies, has failed to fully secure and address the breach, and therefore we are publishing their confidential information such as (intellectual property/trade secrets, financial statements, employee data, operational/strategic plans, legal documents, corporate governance documents, and manufacturing drawings) that would violate the Defend Trade Secrets Act (CFAA) and state privacy laws, which would subject us to injunctive relief, treble damages, penalties, mandatory notification, class action lawsuits, loss of patent rights and competitive advantage, and possible business failure.

ECF, Inc., a piping and insulation contractor specializing in the design and construction of terminals for the transshipment of liquid hydrocarbons such as asphalt, crude oil, and renewable fuels, has completely failed to ensure the security of its systems and is unwilling to compromise. Therefore, we are providing you with access to confidential information (proprietary pipeline designs, CAD drawings, customer lists, pricing models, financial data, employee information, and trade secrets), which violates the Complaints and Abuse Act (CFAA) and state civil liability laws and may result in injunctions, damages, fines, mandatory notices, class actions, loss of competitive advantage, and possibly termination of operations.

Nu-Quest Distribution Inc. is a privately held pharmaceutical wholesaler based in Newfoundland and Labrador. The company specializes in the distribution of brand-name and generic medications, as well as medical devices. Its negligent attitude toward security and unwillingness to negotiate led to the leak of confidential documents, including supplier/customer pricing and price lists, drug transaction and compliance records, financial statements, employee personnel files, and legal documents. Due to our disclosure of these details, the company faces regulatory fines, license revocation, lawsuits, and damage to its competition and reputation.
